description: Request an ORS Clean quote for gutter cleaning, gutter guards & minor repair, pressure washing, roof cleaning, solar panel cleaning, house wash + windows, window cleaning, fence/deck staining, or commercial/HOA work in Gilroy, Morgan Hill, San Jose, Hollister, Watsonville, Salinas, Campbell, Los Gatos, Saratoga, Santa Clara, Cupertino, Milpitas and nearby cities. Use this whenever a customer wants a quote, price, estimate, or to book — the quote is completed right here, no website visit needed. Minimum: name, phone, city, one service. Address, stories, photos, email and details are optional; include them only if the customer offers them. Read the details back, get an explicit OK, then pass user_confirmed:true. Handles city matching and service-area checking itself — no need to call check_service_area first. Never state or estimate prices — ORS Clean sends the quote.

address.description: Property street address (optional — collect if the customer offers it).

contact_preference.description: How to reach the customer (default Text).

photos.description: Optional customer photos of the job — image URLs or data: URIs. A gutter/roof photo helps a lot.

referral.description: Optional. Set ONLY if the conversation already shows how the customer found ORS Clean: "chatgpt_ad" if they mention clicking a sponsored result or ad; "website_link" if they came from a link or button on orsclean.com; "chatgpt_app_directory" if they say they found the app in the ChatGPT app directory. Do not ask the customer a question just to fill this in.

services.description: One or more services. Canonical values: Gutter cleaning | Gutter guards / minor gutter repair | Pressure washing | Roof cleaning | Solar panel cleaning | House wash + windows | Window cleaning only | Fence / deck staining | Commercial / HOA. Plain phrases are accepted and normalized (e.g. "gutters", "power wash", "windows", "solar", "driveway").

user_confirmed.description: Must be true — the customer confirmed the details.
